model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training rewards for different reinforcement learning agents across a series of steps. The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 50. The y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” extends from 0 to 0.4, with tick intervals of 0.05. A solid black line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” agent, which initially exhibits a training reward around 0.1, increasing to approximately 0.35 after 300 steps, and then flattening out around 0.37 at the end of the data. A dashed red line represents the “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” agent, which begins with a training reward of approximately 0.1, rising to a peak reward of around 0.3 at 150 steps, and subsequently decreasing to approximately 0.25 at the end of the data. Finally, a dotted brown line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” agent, which starts at approximately 0.05, rises to a reward of roughly 0.18 after 200 steps before declining to around 0.12 at the 450 step mark. The “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” agent shows a similar pattern to the “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” agent, beginning at 0.05 and reaching a reward of 0.15 at around 180 steps before decreasing to approximately 0.1 at the end of the data.
